name: Gossipers
overview: Scripture condemns gossip and talebearing as destructive behaviors that harm relationships and offend the Lord. The Lord commands His people not to act as talebearers or whisperers who sow strife and reveal secrets, emphasizing that such actions separate close friends and promote division. Instead, the faithful are called to conceal matters and seek love by covering transgressions rather than repeating them. These verses reveal that gossip is not merely a social fault but an abomination to God, warranting serious spiritual consequences.
